## 5. Coverage, adjustment, scale, known_at and mode rules

- **mode_rule**: batch and full replay only; known_at and reconstruction availability modes give identical results; update, restore and merge are unsupported (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY); output at target t is independent of every slot after t (prefix property, PX01 to PX03)
- **grid_context**: relative_stats and daily_log_volatility: local DailyGrid bound to the config by SHA-256 (Amendment 1 item 4); intraday_realized_variance: R17 context. daily closes are BAR rows on a daily governed grid with R17 grid and slot-coverage conventions: one slot per governed session, [start_ns,end_ns) session bounds, session_id, grid/calendar identity, target slot and per-slot coverage from the R17 context; one bar per session per role; no DAILY-kind input
- **layer_responsibilities**:
  - **library**: admission of supplied closes, alignment and pair validity, returns, windowed sums, beta, correlation, residual, log volatility and realized variance with the stated exactness and accuracy, quality, evidence and every refusal; pure and deterministic; shared per-pair preparation reused by the three relative outputs without coupling their readiness; no acquisition, clock, I/O, calendar lookup or sorting
  - **ef3_io_611**: maps ordered closes with known_at into the BAR roles exactly as supplied, the daily governed grid and coverage into the R17 context, the single benchmark identity into config; maps results (float64 hex-exact values, status, reasons, counts, witnesses) to the sink conversion; never derives a return, fills or interpolates a missing close, picks a benchmark, normalizes scale, currency or adjustment, injects a default window, minimum, annualization or threshold
  - **worker_612**: routes selected outputs with exact warm-up closure, shares per-pair preparation within resource bounds, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and the config digest, persists the library result unchanged; direct, worker and stored results identical including refusal class
